How to open a JPEG XL (.jxl) file

A .jxl file is a JPEG XL image - not a camera app or Java library. Here is the fastest way to see it.

Fastest: preview right here

No install. Your file never leaves this device.

Open the local viewer ->
1
Drop your file

Drag one .jxl into the viewer, click to choose, or paste it.

2
View on-device

Native display when supported, otherwise our local decoder fills in.

3
Save if needed

Export JPG or PNG to share anywhere.

Desktop software (optional)

If you prefer an app, use official builds only:

  • ImageMagick - official builds
  • libjxl tools (cjxl / djxl)
What is a .jxl file?

A still image in the JPEG XL format.

Is it safe?

Files here never leave your device; closing the tab discards them.

Why won't Chrome open it?

Native support varies by version - this site falls back to a local decoder.
